messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-8421 — production inference-gateway (us-west-2) high 5xx error rate. 1m aggregated rate = 18.6% (>15% threshold). Routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Impact: increased latencies and client retries. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-8421
Jordan (oncall): acked on PD and jumping in. I'll triage until handoff.
Sasha: looking at Grafana — spike started ~12:30 UTC, error codes mostly 502/503 coming from gateway-frontend -> backend:inference-svc. CPU for gateway nodes is normal, but connection errors to backend pods.
Mike: any infra deploys or config changes in last 20m?
Kat: there was a small canary rolled 15m ago to us-west-2 for routing changes (traffic-split) — I paused it at 12:35 but need to confirm full rollback.
pagerduty: Escalation: 2m unacked by SRE manager, paging on-call backup.
SRE Ana: I'm on it, putting checklist: 1) confirm rollback, 2) isolation (route to eu), 3) check backend pods for evictions. Jordan — can you capture a request trace id?
Jordan (oncall): grabbing trace from an error sample: trace=txc-72f1a3e4; sending request header dump.
ops-bot: recent events from k8s in inference namespace:
```
12:30:42 kubernetes: pod/inference-svc-5 coredump? connection refused
12:31:07 kube-proxy: conntrack timeout warnings
12:32:10 autoscaler: no scale events
12:33:05 pod/inference-svc-7 OOMKilled
```
Sasha: OOMs are showing on a subset of inference pods, not all. Patterns look like memory pressure under certain request sizes (long contexts). The gateway is retrying and causing a storm of new requests — retries -> more load.
Mike: can we temporarily disable client retries at gateway layer or enforce 429s?
Kat: I can flip traffic-split to remove canary and send all routed traffic to eu-west-1 as fallback. That should buy us time.
Ryan (eng-lead): prioritize customer-facing mitigation first — if eu has capacity, shift traffic. Also start pulling logs for the canary image.
Jordan (oncall): executing routing command now: `rdctl routes set inference-prod --region us-west-2 --split 0` (confirming).
ops-bot: command executed, new routing: canary weight -> 0; live config timestamped 12:36:20 UTC.
SRE Ana: good. Next: scale inference-svc replicas + remove memory limits for rollout debug. Jordan, can you patch the deployment to bump replicas from 6->12?
Jordan (oncall): patching: `kubectl scale deploy inference-svc --replicas=12 -n prod` -> request sent.
ops-bot: scale accepted, new replica count 12; rolling update started.
Sasha: after routing switch and scale we see error rate dropping to ~6% within 90s. Latency for /v1/generate back to baseline. Looks like retries + a set of OOM-prone pods were the multiplier.
pagerduty: INC-8421 acknowledged and assigned to Jordan — escalation stopped.
Mike: followup items: 1) investigate canary image memory regression, 2) add circuit-breaker/backoff at gateway to reduce retry storms, 3) add K8s OOM metrics alert threshold.
Kat: I'll open a rollback/regen PR for the canary and pin to previous image.
SRE Ana: assign postmortem and add eval tests for large-context request shapes. Putting myself as owner for the RCA.
Jordan (oncall): notifying CS for customers who saw elevated errors in last 20m. ETA for full debrief: 30m.
Ryan (eng-lead): good triage, folks. Add runbook note: when inference-svc OOM spawns, prefer traffic drain -> scale -> perf fix; avoid immediate global rollback unless necessary.
Sasha: one more note — we saw a client that retried with exponential backoff disabled; reach out to that partner for best practices.
Jordan (oncall): will follow up. Closing PD incident once metrics stable for 15m.
ops-bot: monitoring window opened for 30m; will post summary when stable.
SRE Ana: thanks everyone. Marking thread for handoff to morning shift if still open. :white_check_mark:
